title: THE EMPTY CASE

floorplan.camera: from the floor beside the low trunk at the near end of the luggage car, looking diagonally across the open case toward the dynamo cupboard

anchors.LUGGAGE CAR: narrow wood-panelled baggage car, swaying gently
anchors.LOW TRUNK: a low brass-bound steamer trunk at the near end, its lid shut
anchors.RACK WALL: the car's left wall, stacked trunks under rope netting
anchors.DYNAMO CUPBOARD: a low iron cupboard at the far end, its door open on darkness, the brush holder empty
anchors.CORRIDOR DOOR: the door the camera crouches in

cast.depth: near, crouched over the open case
cast.action: crouches at the low trunk over the open empty case, her right palm pressed hard over her eyes, fingers spread, her left hand holding the brass loupe down at her knee, jaw tight, shoulders squared — she is covering her eyes in furious disbelief, her face turned from the rock
cast.gaze_target: the dark grey rock, hidden behind her hand

cast.depth: behind Lucy, half-turned toward the cupboard
cast.action: stands behind Lucy, the chunky railway torch in his right hand pointed straight down at the dark grey rock on the floor, its hard beam pinning the rock in a circle of light, the opened hollow brush cap in his left hand tilted so the empty velvet nest shows; the screwdriver lies on the cupboard sill

cast.depth: at the open cupboard, low in frame
cast.action: sits at the open dynamo cupboard with one front paw on the door, her head snapped around to her left to stare at the dark grey rock on the floor, ears bolt upright, eyes huge with tiny pupils, jaw dropped in an exaggerated super-shocked expression — the find lands as a shock

props.anchor: LOW TRUNK: open flat in the near foreground, its empty velvet bed in the torch spill
props.description: the same small brass-bound case from the boarding platform, its gold metal exterior and deep blue velvet bed, open and empty: a shallow diamond-shaped hollow with two thin gold prongs sprung wide, a faint pale ring in the velvet where the stone sat
props.state: the case lies open and empty of its diamond, the velvet bed bare

props.anchor: LUGGAGE CAR: on the boards below the open case, in the torch beam
props.description: a dark grey rock the size of a pigeon's egg, rough and matte, with one chipped flat face, a plain rough stone with a dull even surface
props.state: the rock is the fake; it lies on the floor, untouched

props.anchor: DYNAMO CUPBOARD: opened in Wyatt's left hand, tilted so the empty velvet nest shows
props.description: a hollow black dynamo brush cap with a fringe of copper bristles at its rim, pried open, the velvet nest inside empty

props.anchor: DYNAMO CUPBOARD: in his right hand, pointed straight down at the dark grey rock
props.description: a chunky black railway torch, lit, throwing a narrow hard beam

props.anchor: LOW TRUNK: held down at Lucy's knee
DYNAMO CUPBOARD: lying on the cupboard sill

moment: The theft lands in one look: the diamond is gone, the case is empty, the stone on the floor is a dark grey rock, and the hiding place is empty. Cyndi is super-shocked; Lucy is furious; Wyatt keeps the torch on the rock.
environment: stacked leather trunks roped under netting along the rack wall; an overhead baggage rack; one swaying caged bulb; coiled hoses and an oil can; glass dust glittering across the boards; one scuff mark wiped smooth as rubber; tall night windows showing black rushing dark.
lighting: the caged bulb a dim ambient wash; Wyatt's torch the hard dramatic source, pointed straight down at the dark grey rock, pinning it in a hard circle of light; the empty case in the torch spill, the cupboard in shadow; deep shadow beyond.
colour: full colour — warm wood, brass trunk corners, red-brown leather; the dull grey metal of the cupboard; the empty case's gold metal and deep blue velvet; the dark grey rock matte and dull at the centre of the beam; the torch beam cold blue-white.
negatives: the rock is a plain matte dark-grey stone with a dull even surface
the dark grey rock lies matte and dull on the velvet bed of the case
the case lies open on its deep blue velvet bed, its tray empty
exactly one rock appears in the frame
the case is the same gold-brass case from the boarding platform, its bed of deep blue velvet
the only objects in the frame are the rock, its case, the luggage and the gang's own props
luggage stickers are plain blank shapes, and every surface carrying print instead carries flat colour
clean costumes and undamaged props throughout
Cyndi's gaze is fixed on the rock
Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck
